Raghu Bharvad greets Swamishri today on Hari Jayanti with a couple of words in English. "Happy Birthday." He then affirms in Gujarati, "Today is Ghanshyam Maharaj's birthday."

Aruni Bhagat explains that Raghu would like Swamishri to convey his birthday wishes to Ghanshyam Maharaj. Raghu Bharvad then timely adds, "As it is Hari Jayanti today, Bapa, I am going to fast!" Swamishri happily blessed him, and moved on.
